name: Ursula
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 375 Ursula: diameter 216 km; JPL's stated reference: Dunham occult. list: Millis et al. 1984a
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 216 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Ursula. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: A. Charlois found Ursula at Nice on 18 September 1893.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 216 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
